trace_summary.task_objective: A fixed three-hop retrieval pipeline over Wikipedia abstracts. Performs exactly three retrievals and returns the concatenation of everything retrieved. The program has no verification stage, no completeness check, no early-exit condition, no deduplication, and no relevance filter. Only four generated steps exist: summarize_hop1, generate_query_hop2, summarize_hop2, generate_query_hop3.
trace_summary.final_output_summary: 24 documents returned across three hops. Hop 1 retrieved documents about Jason Pinkston, Todd Pinkston, and various offensive linemen. Hop 2 retrieved documents about Ebbets Field confirming it hosted three NFL teams in the 1920s and was demolished in 1960. Hop 3 retrieved documents including Brooklyn Dodgers (NFL), which is the key missing piece identifying one of the 1920s NFL teams at Ebbets Field.
trace_summary.summary: The three-hop retrieval pipeline executed all seven specified steps successfully. Hop 1 retrieved documents establishing the Jason Pinkston/Todd Pinkston family relationship. Hop 2 retrieved documents confirming Ebbets Field hosted NFL teams in the 1920s. Hop 3 retrieved documents including 'Brooklyn Dodgers (NFL)', which identifies one of the historical NFL teams at Ebbets Field. The summarizer steps produced verification-oriented reasoning (identifying the claim as unverifiable due to present-tense phrasing and demolished stadium), and the query generator steps produced retrieval queries that successfully narrowed toward the historical NFL teams at Ebbets Field. All documents were concatenated and returned as specified. The pipeline completed its structural obligations: three retrievals occurred, four generated steps ran, and documents were assembled into final output.
